candidates.violated_requirement: Gray-to-binary conversion should use XOR operations to correctly decode the Gray code. Replacing XOR with OR will cause incorrect binary values to be calculated, leading to wrong Gray code outputs after conversion.
candidates.spec_basis: The specification states: 'Convert the Gray code to binary representation' using XOR operations for correct decoding

candidates.violated_requirement: Final bit of Gray-to-binary conversion must use XOR to properly decode. Using AND instead will produce incorrect binary values, causing subsequent Gray code outputs to be wrong.
candidates.spec_basis: Specification requires correct Gray-to-binary conversion using XOR operations

candidates.violated_requirement: Binary-to-Gray conversion requires XOR operation to ensure only one bit changes between consecutive values. Using OR will violate the single-bit change property of Gray code.
candidates.spec_basis: Specification states: 'Gray code is a binary numeral system where two successive values differ in only one bit position'
